title: Add a high priority task and mark it done
style: Read this in a calm, friendly and unhurried voice, as if showing a colleague

lines.text: In Tidy, you can track urgent work by adding tasks with high priority.
lines._spoken: In Tidy, you can track urgent work by adding tasks with high priority.
lines._voice: gemini|gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts|Charon|Read this in a calm, friendly and unhurried voice, as if showing a colleague

lines.text: Type what needs doing in the box at the top.

lines._voice: gemini|gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts|Charon|Read this in a calm, friendly and unhurried voice, as if showing a colleague

lines.text: From the Priority menu, select High.

lines.text: Click Add task to place it on your list with a red High badge.
